data.long_meaning: Japanese name derived from the Chinese characters ‘知’ (chi) meaning ‘know’ and ‘臣’ (samurai) meaning ‘servant’. The name Kenzo can be interpreted as 'wise servant'. In Japan, it was a common name for samurai leaders. The name Kenzo carries the meaning “Wise and Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kenzo usually hope their child will grow to embody wise and intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing wisdom and service.
data.etymology: Kenzo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise and Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenzo total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: During the Edo period (1603-1868), the name Kenzo gained popularity among the Japanese lower class, particularly artisans and craftsmen. It became a symbol of dedication, skill, and wisdom, representing the importance of knowledge and craftsmanship in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kenzo holds a significant spiritual meaning for Christians as well. Its roots in the Chinese characters 'know' and 'servant' reflect the Christian belief in serving God with knowledge and understanding. The name can be seen as a reminder to use our God-given knowledge and skills to serve Him and others, embodying the spiritual virtues of wisdom, humility, and service.
